note: V28.15 Cable in manual single-line builder: each line gets a cable type (DB cables + fixed list) and length (m), with auto-suggestion by breaker nominal (C10->3x1.5, C16->3x2.5, C25->3x4, C32->3x6, editable). On transfer to the configurator (manual mode), cable is summed by type into material lines ('Кабель ... (N м)'), priced from the DB (tolerant match for 3х2,5 / 3*2.5 formats), and flows to the estimate with consumables. Shared module modules/shield/cable-v28.js (window.EPCableV28). Configurator-side per-line cable editing is the next step.
